items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I know Jockey Bill in Prescott. I remember him.

ctx.x: Well, I want it all but I was asking you about the early ones first.

Well, the early ones first--I know Jockey Bill in Prescott. I remember him. He played a lot of old ragtime things but he had a wonderful tenor voice. Gee, he was beautiful. I mean, he called him Jockey Bill because, even when he was so small, he used to ...he was a little guy but he hung around the races until he got... until he started playing piano for a living and everything, and he was singing and playing in the saloons. He had a beautiful voice, and he played that old ragtime stuff. It's all blues, you know,…
How about when you got to Kansas City? Uh, what was happening in Kansas City? Was there any good musicians there that you heard? Were you there long enough to hear any?
